channel.title: Coastal Eventures: upcoming events
channel.description: The next 40 dated events on the Gulf Coast.

item.title: Adventure Zone at Steve's Fishing and Adventure Farm (SAT 11/28)
item.description: Mon-Sat through Dec 12 · weekdays 12 PM to 5 PM and Saturdays 9 AM to 5 PM from Nov 20 | Steve's Fishing and Adventure Farm | from $19.45. Steve's Farm has rebranded as Steve's Fishing and Adventure Farm and opened a fall attraction in Walnut Hill with a corn maze, a giant slide, a kids' zipline, a jump pad, hayrides, a wagon train, a sunflower field and a pumpkin patch. It suits a family with small children who want a half day outdoors. The farm's ticket page lists day passes at $15.00 to $19.45 and a $35 season pass, so check it for each day's hours before driving out.

item.title: Coastal Half Marathon, 5K and 1 Mile Fun Run (SAT 11/28)
item.description: Saturday 11/28 · half marathon 8:00 AM, 5K 8:10 AM, 1 mile 8:20 AM | Orange Beach Sportsplex | from $22.20. The 19th annual post-Thanksgiving race at the Orange Beach Sportsplex offers a half marathon, a 5K and a 1 mile fun run on the paved Hugh S. Branyon Backcountry Trail system near Gulf State Park. The half marathon starts at 8:00 AM, the 5K at 8:10 AM and the fun run at 8:20 AM, with a post-race party and awards from 9 AM to 11 AM.

item.title: Game Days at Marina Bar & Grill (SAT 11/28)
item.description: Saturdays (college football) and Sundays (NFL), plus select Monday and Thursday nights | Marina Bar & Grill, Sandestin Golf and Beach Resort | No published price. Marina Bar & Grill at Baytowne Marina runs its own Game Days program, showing NCAA football on Saturdays and NFL games on Sundays plus select Monday and Thursday nights. It sits right on the marina at Sandestin.

item.title: Glass and resin Christmas class with Anita O'dell at Coastal Makers (SAT 11/28)
item.description: Saturday 11/28 · 10:00 AM to 12:00 PM or 1:00 PM to 3:00 PM | Coastal Makers | from $40. Anita O'dell guides a class at Coastal Makers where each guest builds a Christmas piece from crushed glass, baubles and beads. Guests pick a 4 by 12 inch canvas or an 8 by 10 inch wood base, and the piece gets a coat of resin. It cures overnight and goes home the next day. There are two sessions.

item.title: Gulf Breeze Optimist Club Christmas Tree Sale (SAT 11/28)
item.description: Weekdays 3:30 PM to 7:00 PM, weekends 9:00 AM to 7:00 PM | Gulf Breeze High School | No published price. The Optimist Club of Gulf Breeze sells Fraser fir Christmas trees, 5 to 10 feet tall, from the Gulf Breeze High School baseball field at the corner of Highway 98 and Daniel Circle, with high school students and their parents helping on the lot. The money goes back to local schools through the year.

item.title: Ice skating rink presented by Pepsi at The Wharf (SAT 11/28)
item.description: Daily from 11/13 · hours vary by day | The Wharf | from $16. The Wharf in Orange Beach opens a real ice rink for the holiday season on November 13 and keeps it open through January 18. Skates are provided, beginners are welcome, and a DJ plays Friday and Saturday nights from 7:00 PM to 10:00 PM. On Tuesdays through December 8 the Wharf donates $5 to Toys for Tots for each skate purchase.

item.title: Jazz Art Writers South Festival Youth Exhibit 2026 (SAT 11/28)
item.description: Nov 1 to Dec 15 · all day during branch hours, closed Sundays | Monte L. Moorer/Spring Hill Branch Library | No published price. More than fifty paintings by artists ages 8 to 18 who attend local public schools interpret jazz music at the Monte L. Moorer/Spring Hill Branch Library. The JAWS Festival put the exhibit together with the Mobile Arts Council and the Amp Up Arts Program, and it hangs from November 1 through December 15 during branch hours, which are Monday to Saturday.

item.title: Kids Night Out at the Pensacola MESS Hall (SAT 11/28)
item.description: Friday 11/20 · 6:00 PM to 8:00 PM · Friday 12/4 · 6:00 PM to 8:00 PM | Pensacola MESS Hall | from $20. The Pensacola MESS Hall gives parents a Friday night off on November 20 and December 4. Kids in grade 1 and up spend two hours on hands-on science, games and cheese pizza. A child with a different meal in mind can bring one, and everyone should bring a water bottle.

item.title: Lion Trot 8K, 5K and Fun Run (SAT 11/28)
item.description: Saturday 11/28 · 8K 8:00 AM, 5K 8:10 AM, Fun Run 9:15 AM | Amelia Park, Saraland | from $15. The Lion Trot runs an 8K, a 5K and a fun run from Amelia Park in Saraland on the Saturday after Thanksgiving. Youth 13 and under pay less, and the fun run starts and finishes at James Street and First Avenue. Order by November 20 to be sure of a shirt.

item.title: Make Your Own Glass (hot glass, by appointment) (SAT 11/28)
item.description: By appointment: Wednesdays 5 PM-9 PM, Saturdays 8 AM-11 AM | First City Art Center | from $85. Make Your Own Glass is a hands-on hot glass session at First City Art Center in Pensacola, where each participant makes a piece with a glassblower. It's for ages 8 and up including adults, by appointment on Wednesdays from 5-9 PM and Saturdays from 8-11 AM. The finished piece cools in an annealing oven and is picked up the following week. Standard pieces cost $85, and premium pieces such as a pumpkin, ornament, cup or bowl cost $110-$140.

item.title: Mobile in the Gilded Age exhibition at the History Museum of Mobile (SAT 11/28)
item.description: Monday to Saturday 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM · Sunday 1:00 PM to 5:00 PM · through 6/6/2027 | History Museum of Mobile | from $8. The History Museum of Mobile opened Mobile in the Gilded Age on October 9, 2026, and the exhibition stays up through June 6, 2027. Gowns, inventions and everyday objects show how railroads, new technology and department stores changed life in Mobile in the late 1800s and early 1900s. The exhibition also covers the unequal opportunities and segregation of the period.

item.title: Mobile Music Legends exhibit at Moorer Branch Library (SAT 11/28)
item.description: Library hours · 11/1 to 12/15 · closed Sundays | Monte L. Moorer/Spring Hill Branch Library | No published price. The Monte L. Moorer/Spring Hill Branch Library hosts the first annual Mobile Music Legends exhibit. The display celebrates artists and ensembles who carried the soul, jazz and spirit of the Gulf Coast to the world. The exhibit stays up from November 1 to December 15.

item.title: Moneybagg Yo at the Mobile Saenger (SAT 11/28)
item.description: Saturday 11/28 · 8:00 PM, doors 7:00 PM | Saenger Theatre, Mobile | No published price. Yungfly Entertainment presents Moneybagg Yo at the Saenger Theatre in downtown Mobile. The theatre calls the night chart-topping hits and signature Southern hip-hop. Tickets are sold only through Ticketmaster and the box office, and the page does not print a price or an age rule.

item.title: Moonlight Garden photography exhibition by Mark Alan Francis (SAT 11/28)
item.description: Through Friday 12/11 · Mon to Thu 9 AM to 5 PM, Fri 9 AM to 3 PM | Switzer Gallery, Pensacola State College | No published price. Mark Alan Francis shows landscape photographs made with the Mordançage process, which leaves copper, tan and burnt sienna tones in black-and-white silver gelatin prints. The prints look as if they were shot at night under moonlight. The show hangs in the Switzer Gallery from November 5 through December 11.

item.title: Painting with a Twist Pensacola: paint-and-sip, family paint days and date nights (weekly programme) (SAT 11/28)
item.description: Classes most days: family days Saturday 10:30 AM, brunch Sunday 11 AM, evenings Wednesday to Saturday | Painting with a Twist Pensacola | $35 per family. Painting with a Twist Pensacola is an artist-led paint-and-sip studio at 4771 Bayou Blvd Suite C11 with several classes every week. October has family paint days (ages 6 and up with a parent, no alcohol), adult Paint & Sip and Date Night classes (ages 16 and up on date nights), Halloween-themed canvases and Paint Your Pet. Classes cost $35-$60 depending on the class, and alcohol is sold on site with no BYOB.

item.title: Photos with Santa at The Wharf (SAT 11/28)
item.description: Fridays to Sundays 11/13 to 12/24 · Fri 3 PM to 6 PM, Sat 10 AM to 6 PM, Sun 12 PM to 6 PM | The Wharf | No published price. The Wharf in Orange Beach sets up Photos with Santa on Fridays through Sundays from November 13 to December 24. Friday hours run 3:00 PM to 6:00 PM, Saturday 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM and Sunday 12:00 PM to 6:00 PM. The Wharf sells various price packages, and the ice rink sits next door at the same property.

item.title: Pokémon League at GameMasters Guild (SAT 11/28)
item.description: Thursdays 3 PM-8 PM and Saturdays 12 PM-2 PM | GameMasters Guild | Free. Pokémon League at GameMasters Guild is free casual play for the Pokémon TCG, the Pokémon Champions video game and Pokémon GO. It runs Thursdays from 3 to 8 PM and Saturdays from 12 to 2 PM in Crestview. All ages are welcome, and the shop calls it a family-friendly space. Players get promo cards or special items while supplies last, and a free Pokémon account is needed to qualify (children under 13 register under a parent's account).

item.title: Polar Express Holiday Tea at Ovide (SAT 11/28)
item.description: Saturday 11/28 · 1:00 PM or 3:00 PM | Ovide at Hotel Effie Sandestin | from $29. Ovide at Hotel Effie serves a Polar Express themed tea with a live Hot Chocolate performance by Emerald Coast Theatre. The menu has tea sandwiches, snacks, desserts and a hot chocolate bar. Two seatings run on Saturday 11/28, one at 1:00 PM and one at 3:00 PM, each lasting about an hour and a half.

item.title: Santa's Letters to the North Pole mailbox at Destin Commons (SAT 11/28)
item.description: Friday 11/20 · open during center hours · through Sunday 12/13 | Destin Commons | Free. Children can write a letter to Santa and drop it in the North Pole mailbox on South Street, in front of Chipotle. Every child who submits a letter is entered to win a family staycation package. The mailbox is up from November 20 through December 13.

item.title: Shop, Dine and Explore Holiday Kickoff in Navarre (SAT 11/28)
item.description: Friday 11/27 and Saturday 11/28 · business hours | Participating Navarre businesses | Free. The Navarre Beach Area Chamber turns Black Friday and Small Business Saturday into a prize drawing for shopping local. Spend at least $25 at a participating business and each receipt is one entry, with a $250 #ShopNavarreFirst gift card as the grand prize. Receipts are due by 11:59 PM Sunday, November 29, and winners are drawn live on Facebook on Monday.

item.title: Story Time and Craft at Foley Community Library (SAT 11/28)
item.description: Tuesdays 10:00 AM and 5:30 PM · Saturdays 10:00 AM | Foley Community Library | No published price. The Foley Community Library holds a story time with a craft every Tuesday and Saturday from August through May. Tuesday sessions run at 10:00 AM and 5:30 PM, and the Saturday session runs at 10:00 AM. No age limit or price is posted.

item.title: Teen Dungeons and Dragons at Moorer (SAT 11/28)
item.description: Saturdays 11:30 AM to 1:30 PM · Tuesdays 4:00 PM to 6:00 PM | Monte L. Moorer/Spring Hill Branch Library | No published price. The Monte L. Moorer/Spring Hill Branch Library runs a tabletop Dungeons & Dragons adventure for teens ages 12 to 18. Registration is recommended, and upcoming sessions include Tuesday, November 3, Saturday, November 14, Tuesday, November 17, and Saturday, November 28.

item.title: The View Within exhibition at Blue Morning Gallery (SAT 11/28)
item.description: Sunday 10/25 to Saturday 11/28 · reception Friday 11/6 at 4:30 | Blue Morning Gallery | No published price. Blue Morning Gallery in downtown Pensacola shows The View Within, an exhibition of colorful abstract paintings by the featured artist, from October 25 through November 28. A reception on Friday November 6 at 4:30 lets visitors meet the artist, hear live music and enjoy refreshments and conversation.

item.title: Trim-a-Tree at the Foley Art Center (SAT 11/28)
item.description: Friday 11/13 to Wednesday 12/23 · daily (hours to confirm) | Foley Art Center | Free. Since 1967 the Foley Art Center has opened its Trim-a-Tree holiday show on the second Friday in November, and it runs through December 23. More than 125 local artists and craftspeople sell pottery, woodcarvings, florals, jewelry, blown glass, textiles, soy candles, wooden toys and ornaments on consignment. Admission is free.

item.title: Wanda Sullivan: Bloem Exhibition (SAT 11/28)
item.description: Now through December 11 | Anna Lamar Switzer Center for Visual Arts | No published price. A gallery exhibition by artist Wanda Sullivan runs at Pensacola State College's visual arts center through mid-December. The center's own site does not publish an admission price.

item.title: Grand Breakfast and Pictures with Santa at the Grand Hotel (SAT 11/28)
item.description: Saturday 11/28 · 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM | Grand Hotel Golf Resort & Spa | from $32.95. The Grand Hotel serves a holiday breakfast buffet with an omelet station, a waffle station and pastries while Santa visits the tables. Renaissance Portrait Studio takes the photos, and a session has to be booked after buying breakfast tickets. Seating is limited and there are no door sales.

item.title: Audubon Destin shorebirds bird walk (SAT 11/28)
item.description: Saturday 11/28 · 7:30 AM | Destin CVS parking lot, Highway 98 and Main Street | Free. Choctawhatchee Audubon Society leads a Saturday morning shorebird walk in Destin. The group meets at 7:30 AM in the CVS parking lot at Highway 98 and Main Street, opposite Regions Bank. Walkers should dress for the weather and be ready to carpool.

item.title: Parkrun: Free Timed 5K (Rec Plex North) (SAT 11/28)
item.description: Saturdays · 7:30 AM | UWF Rec Plex North Field | Free. A free, timed, all-comers 5K runs every Saturday. Walk, run, or push the jogging stroller. The kids can earn official times too, with one-time free barcode registration.

item.title: Ride MORE Bicycles Saturday Shop Ride (SAT 11/28)
item.description: Saturdays · 7:30 AM | Ride MORE Bicycles | No published price. The Ride MORE Bicycles Saturday Shop Ride is a weekly road group ride that leaves the shop at 59 E Gregory St. in Pensacola. It covers about 30 miles at a 17-19 mph average, with sprints and regrouping spots. The ride runs 7:30-9:30 AM every Saturday and road bikes are required.

item.title: Breakfast with Billy Claus at LuLu's Destin (SAT 11/28)
item.description: Saturday 11/28 · 8:00 AM to 10:00 AM | LuLu's Destin | from $8. Billy Claus and the LuLuBelles host a holiday breakfast at LuLu's on the Destin harbor. The morning includes a buffet, build-your-own blue pancakes, a blue hot chocolate stand, do-it-yourself surfboard ornaments, letters to Santa, storytime and photos with Billy and the LuLuBelles. Bloody Marys are sold at the Destin location for the adults. The event page lists no reservation link, so call the restaurant to ask how seats are held.

item.title: Breakfast with Billy Claus at LuLu's Gulf Shores (SAT 11/28)
item.description: Saturday 11/28 · 8:00 AM to 10:00 AM | LuLu's Gulf Shores | Free. Billy Claus, Santa's sunshine-loving younger brother from Lucy Buffett's book Billy Claus and the Spirit of Christmas Island, comes to LuLu's Gulf Shores for breakfast. The buffet has build-your-own blue pancakes, bacon, sausage patties, scrambled eggs, biscuits and sausage gravy and fruit, with blue hot chocolate to drink. Joining the holiday fun is free and you do not have to buy breakfast: kids decorate surfboard ornaments, write letters to Santa, hear the LuLuBelles read the book around 9 AM and meet Billy at about 9:15 for photos.

item.title: Downtown FWB Saturday Market (SAT 11/28)
item.description: 8:00 AM to 1:00 PM | Fort Walton Beach Landing Park | Free. The Downtown FWB Saturday Market sets up at Fort Walton Beach Landing Park on the waterfront from 8 AM to 1 PM, free to browse for the whole family. Local artisans, produce growers, and other vendors fill the park on the second and fourth Saturday of every month, year-round. Walking the market alongside the water is as much the point as the shopping.

item.title: The Grayt Jackalope 5 Mile and 10 Mile Trail Race (SAT 11/28)
item.description: Saturday 11/28 · 8:00 AM | Grayton Beach State Park, Trailhead 30A | from $60. The Grayt Jackalope is a Thanksgiving weekend trail run through Grayton Beach State Park, with a 5 mile or 10 mile course starting at 8 AM. Registration is through UltraSignup. The race calls itself better than a turkey trot.

item.title: Ocean Hour Saturday Cleanups: Fall Schedule (SAT 11/28)
item.description: Saturdays 10/24 to 11/28 · 8:45 AM | Ocean Hour cleanup sites around Pensacola | Free. Ocean Hour holds one hour volunteer cleanups on Saturday mornings at 8:45 AM at parks, trailheads and beaches around Pensacola and Pensacola Beach. The fall schedule runs from October 24 through November 28, with two or three sites each week. Volunteers only need closed toe shoes, water and sunscreen, and Ocean Hour supplies all equipment.

item.title: Grand Boulevard Farmers Market (SAT 11/28)
item.description: Saturdays · 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM | Grand Park, Grand Boulevard at Sandestin | Free. Grand Boulevard holds an open-air farmers market every Saturday morning in Grand Park, between Cantina Laredo and Tommy Bahama. Vendors sell produce, meats, dairy, eggs, honey, baked goods, artisanal foods and handmade goods. The market runs year-round in a walkable shopping district.

item.title: Grand Boulevard Farmers' Market (SAT 11/28)
item.description: Saturdays · 9 AM-1 PM | Grand Park, Grand Boulevard at Sandestin | Free. A Saturday farmers and makers market fills the Sandestin green, with local honey, produce, and kettle corn. Pair it with a Destin/Baytowne day.

item.title: Military Weekends at the Gulfarium (SAT 11/28)
item.description: Saturdays and Sundays, 11/28 to 2/28 · 9:00 AM to 4:30 PM | Gulfarium Marine Adventure Park | from $13.48. Every Saturday and Sunday from November 7 through February 28, military ID holders and their immediate families get 50 percent off admission to the Gulfarium. Tickets are bought at the park with a valid military ID. The offer cannot be combined with other discounts. The park is open 9:00 AM to 4:30 PM, and admission closes at 3:30 PM.

item.title: Namaste by the Bay free community yoga at Waterfront Park (SAT 11/28)
item.description: Saturday 9:00 AM | Orange Beach Waterfront Park | Free. Orange Beach Parks and Recreation runs free community yoga by the water on Saturday mornings from 9:00 AM to 10:00 AM, with a different instructor each week. All ages and levels are welcome. The November sessions fall on 11/7, 11/14, 11/21 and 11/28.

item.title: Palafox Market (SAT 11/28)
item.description: Saturdays · 9 AM-2 PM | MLK Jr. Plaza + Plaza Ferdinand, Downtown Pensacola | Free. A big Saturday market fills downtown with produce, local makers, art, and food. A free trolley runs between plazas. It is stroller-friendly.

item.title: Sand Dollar Market at Sand Dollar Plaza in Navarre (SAT 11/28)
item.description: Saturday 11/28 · 9:00 AM to 2:00 PM | Sand Dollar Plaza, Highway 87 | Free. Local vendors set up at Sand Dollar Plaza with handmade jewelry, coastal decor, crafts and seasonal items on Saturday, November 28. The market runs 9:00 AM to 2:00 PM, and admission is free. The tourism listing calls it family friendly.
